difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for morphisms f : X -> Y and g : Y -> Z of algebraic spaces over S, if the composite g o f is locally of finite type then so is f (source lines 4705-4711). The proof produces a three-column diagram of schemes U -> V -> W with surjective etale vertical arrows, and then uses the chapter's local characterization of finite typeness together with the scheme statement that local finite typeness descends along a composite.
